The leading group were quickly away with Young and Lightman making much of the early pace, Eley and Thompson sitting in. Further back Pat Duncan seemed happy to let things go for a while, Dave King and Bob were well up with George Beecham and John settling in to build the team foundations.

Disqualification of Lightman, Thorpe and Wallwork enabled him to gain places without trying and eventually he ended up 10th. Middleton and Moullin walked steadily through pulling back places over the undulating course, and John Hall ambled through as 4th man.
Seddon and Lightman kept him company early on but he then broke away to take a comfortable lead, although Gower of Ilford closed to within 40 metres at the end.

Doug Fotheringham placed 9th in 57:14 with Tim Thorogood one place behind in 58:30. Lightman of Met. WC chalked up yet another win in his club's Phil Embleton Memorial 15Km event in Battersea Park on December 4th.
The event was the Southern 3Km championship won by Lightman (Met WC) in 12:40, although first to cross the line was guest Canadian Marcel Jobin in 12:23.6.
